palette: Current renderer defaults and explicitly supplied demo palettes; see figure_spec
experimental_unit: No biological units; software display fixture
denominator: All supplied fixture rows; explicit denominators in table where applicable
model: No analysis model fitted; illustrative frozen numbers
limits: Renderer defaults or explicit limits in figure_spec
filtering: All supplied fixture rows; no data exclusions for aesthetics
uncertainty: Illustrative synthetic bounds; not research confidence intervals
interpretation_limit: SYNTHETIC DEMO; visual design only, not scientific evidence

figure_spec.density: Scott Gaussian KDE restricted to observed min/max; area visually normalized within group
figure_spec.box: Q1/Q3 linear, median; whiskers at observations within1.5IQR; all raw points retained
